 WASHINGTON (CNN/CNN Newsource/WKRC) - Toyota has recalled thousands of vehicles over an issue that could cause impacted vehicles to shut down.
 More than 30,000 Toyota vehicles have been recalled because of a software issue that could cause the vehicle to lose power or shut down.
 The recall affects 2026 Toyota RAV4 plug-in hybrids. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration says the software issue could cause the hybrid system to reduce power or shut down while the vehicle is traveling at higher speeds, increasing the risk of a crash.
 Toyota dealers will update the software at no cost. Owners will be notified by early December.
